articles.summary: Secunda, South Africa – Sasol today hosted President Cyril Ramaphosa at its Secunda Operations, where he acknowledged the company’s role in South Africa’s economy, industrial capability and job creation. Led by Sasol President and Chief Executive Officer Simon Baloyi, the visit showcased the scale and integration of the Secunda operations, and its role in supporting energy security, industrial development and economic growth.
articles.title: President Ramaphosa visits Sasol Secunda, highlights its contribution to South Africa’s industrial capability
